title: Wakesplit Crystal Cluster
description: A three-metre cluster and opposing side growths erupt through a limestone shelf, leaving an open apron of bare earth.

review.notes: Round 3 (final). Fixed: material is now a darker violet with lighter top facets and faint horizontal bands; vertical streaks are gone; cracks are now visible in the hero view. Not fixed: (1) the main prisms are still built from 3-4 stacked segments with flaring outward rings at regular spacing, so the bamboo-joint read remains (round-2 point 2). (2) All terminations are still clean, unchipped pyramidal points (round-2 point 3). (3) The cracks are flat painted zigzag lines on the faces (cartoon-lightning look), not modelled fractures; the inner bands sit on the surface rather than inside the stone. (4) Prisms are still coarse 6-8-sided low-poly with fully flat facets in closeup.jpg, which is not hero-level detail.
